caveats: Do not use chat models for 768-dimensional collection embeddings.

mxbai-embed-large:latest.use_case_notes: Optional 1024-dimensional embedding model for shadow migrations and provider-specific experiments.
caveats: Do not use for existing 768-dimensional collections without a shadow reindex and evaluated cutover.

qwen3.5:4b.use_case_notes: Tiny/fast general model — small chat, routing/classification, and LLM-rerank fallback. Recommended quant Q8_0 (~4.5 GB) when host capacity allows.
caveats: The bare ':4b' tag pulls Ollama's default quant; pin a quant-specific tag to force Q8_0.

qwen3-vl:4b.use_case_notes: Selected local visual-understanding rung for the measured host: 16376 MiB total VRAM and approximately 5982 MiB free at selection time; the 4B rung fits with headroom and is materially stronger for grounding than the legacy LLaVA fallback.
caveats: Selection is host-dependent; retain the 2B fallback for lower-VRAM machines and do not assume video is routable until a future role is explicitly introduced.
